svg.title: Closed-Loop Research Agenda for Automated Red Teaming
svg.desc: Six detailed research schematics surround a continuous assurance coordinator: discovery, independent decision oracles, remediation, threat transfer, reversible agent execution, and tiered disclosure. Directed evidence flows and governed feedback close the loop. Discovery curves are conceptual; the illustrated Chao1 expression assumes f2 greater than zero.
svg.text: Closed-Loop Research Agenda for Automated Red Teaming
Six open frontiers connect failure discovery to reproducible safety evidence and governed remediation.
Singleton and doubleton counts estimate unseen risk.
Coverage anchors include HarmBench and JailbreakBench.
Search and reporting use separate judgments.
Calibration sets the decision boundary τ.
The search judge guides the optimizer.
Four factors separate sources of score changes.
Remediation uses DPO, Safe-RLHF and unlearning.
Transfer varies across four threat-space axes.
Transfer anchors include PoEX, MultiJail and Any-to-Any.

ns0:svg.aria-label: Poison bottle with skull and crossbones

svg.text: Containers and API boundaries isolate execution.
AgentDojo, AgentPoison and OSWorld anchor testing.
Disclosure uses tiered access and coordinated triage.
Vetted users receive gated artifact access.
FLARE-AI and MITRE ATLAS structure reports.
Vendor triage links evidence, fixes and advisories.
Infrastructure includes Inspect AI and CERT/CC.
Evidence connects discovery, repair and disclosure.
Governed disclosures and regressions renew coverage seeds.
